steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: This topic covers key vocabulary and structures for prepositions and conjunctions. You need to know the topic vocabulary, be able to use it in all four skills (listening, speaking, reading, writing), and express opinions with reasons. | GCSE Spanish Exam Tips: Por vs para is a common exam topic: por = reason/cause, para = purpose/destination. Use prepositions correctly after verbs (depender de, pensar en). Use conjunctions to link ideas and create complex sentences. Use connecting words for fluency.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Write 4 sentences in Spanish about prepositions and conjunctions. | Write a paragraph (40-60 words) giving your opinion on prepositions and conjunctions. | Translate into Spanish: "I think prepositions and conjunctions is important because..."
